column_description: Full name of the user. may be NULL.
Email address of the user. may be NULL.
Role of the user (e.g., producer, director, analyst). always exactly one of 'producer', 'director', 'analyst'. may be NULL.
Date when the user joined the platform. may be NULL.
Date of the user's last login. may be NULL.
User status (e.g., active, inactive). always exactly one of 'active', 'inactive'. may be NULL.
